papers.title: The impact of complex terrain on urban flood resilience under extreme rainfall events
papers.abstractEn: Climate change makes extreme rainfall-driven urban flooding a global challenge. This study builds a hydrodynamic model of urban flooding under extreme rainfall to examine runoff affected by building layouts and flow resistance in complex terrain. Using a resilience framework with real-time simulation data and terrain indices, factor analysis optimizes the framework and yields a flood-resilience formula. Flooded areas concentrate in irregular, dense building zones where extreme-rainfall impacts are amplified. As the irregularity coefficient deviates from 1, building water-resistance strengthens, raising maximum ponding depth by up to 20%. Steeper slopes raise ponding depth 10%-30% but shrink flooded area. The maps guide proactive urban flood planning.
papers.abstractZh: 气候变化下极端降雨致城市洪涝成全球挑战。研究构建极端降雨城市洪涝水动力模型，分析建筑布局与复杂地形水流阻力，用因子分析优化韧性框架并推导洪涝韧性公式。淹没区集中于不规则建筑区，极端降雨影响被放大；不规则系数偏离1越远阻水越强，最大积水增20%；坡度增大使积水深升10%-30%但缩小淹没范围。成果指导城市防洪规划。
papers.value: 揭示复杂地形下极端降雨洪涝机理与韧性评估，对城市防洪规划与水利防灾备考有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Response of soil detachment and erodibility to perennial fibrous-rooted vegetation coverage (Stipa bungeana) on the Loess Plateau
papers.abstractEn: Revegetation is common for soil and water conservation, but how coverage regulates soil detachment (Dr) and erodibility (kr) stays unclear. On the Loess Plateau, we tested five Stipa bungeana coverages (0%-85%) at three sites. Rising coverage lowered bulk density and improved organic matter and roots. Structural equation modeling showed Dr, kr, and critical shear stress were governed by root-soil interactions, with restoration acting via roots. kr responded more to soil (path -0.53) than roots (-0.45), while tc depended mainly on roots. Vegetation reduced Dr across flow intensities, and root influence grew with flow (R2=0.87, P<0.05). Equal-coverage site differences mean local soil factors must be considered when optimizing revegetation.
papers.abstractZh: 植被恢复用于水土保持，但盖度如何调控土壤分离能力与可蚀性尚不清。黄土高原针茅5盖度梯度试验显示，盖度增加改善有机质与根系；结构方程表明二者与临界剪应力受根系-土壤协同调控，可蚀性受土壤影响大于根系，临界剪应力主要靠根系。植被降低不同水流下土壤分离能力。站点差异提示优化恢复须考虑局地土壤。
papers.value: 黄土高原针茅植被盖度对土壤可蚀性的定量调控，直接服务于水土保持植被恢复措施设计与备考。

papers.title: Debris flow forecasting: disastrous rainfall threshold matters
papers.abstractEn: Debris-flow initiation rainfall thresholds are a common forecasting index, but installed drainage channels and check dams mean occurrence may not cause damage, raising false alarms. We defined a disastrous rainfall threshold beyond which flows overflow channels and harm residents in a typical Chinese catchment. The SynxFlow model, coupling rainfall-runoff-debris flow dynamics, simulated overflow under varied intensities and durations, yielding the disastrous I-D threshold I = 8.7D^-1.26 + 30.4. It requires far higher intensity than the initiation threshold: 39.1 mm/h versus 11.9 mm/h for 1-h rainfall. Uniform rainfall gives a higher threshold than delayed, advanced, or intermediate patterns. Separating disastrous from initiation thresholds improves forecasting and early-warning accuracy.
papers.abstractZh: 泥石流启动降雨阈值是常用预报指标，但沟谷有排水渠、拦砂坝等时，发生未必致灾，套用启动阈值易误报。研究在中国典型泥石流沟定义灾难性降雨阈值，用耦合降雨-径流-泥石流过程的模型模拟漫流，拟合出灾难性强度-历时阈值，其强度远高于启动阈值（1小时降雨下39.1 vs 11.9 mm/h）。区分两类阈值可提升预报与预警精度。
papers.value: 提出灾难性降雨阈值概念，区分致灾与启动，对泥石流预警减灾工程设计与水利备考有实用价值。

papers.title: 秦巴山区山坡地表产流阈值多因子协同机理
papers.abstractEn: Hillslope is the basic unit of hydrological response in mountainous small watersheds; revealing the nonlinear threshold characteristics of runoff generation is essential for understanding storm flood mechanisms and improving flash flood early warning. Taking a typical flash-flood-prone small watershed in the Qinba Mountains, this study combined indoor simulated rainfall with field runoff plots to investigate the synergistic control of rainfall intensity, slope gradient, soil thickness and its distribution pattern, and initial soil moisture on surface runoff initiation time. A theoretical model for runoff initiation time was built and a CR+ASM integrated threshold index was proposed. Results show rainfall intensity is the dominant factor and thick soil delays initiation by 35%-50% versus thin soil. The model achieved R2=0.91-0.92 and NSE=0.89-0.92 in laboratory validation, while the CR+ASM index reached R2=0.99 and NSE=0.99. The findings provide a theoretical basis for storm flood simulation and flash flood early warning in mountainous watersheds.
papers.abstractZh: 山坡坡面是山区小流域水文响应基本单元，揭示产流非线性阈值特征对理解暴雨洪水、提升山洪预警意义重大。研究以秦巴山区山洪易发小流域为对象，通过室内外观测构建产流时间理论模型并提出CR+ASM综合阈值指标。雨强为主导因子，厚土层产流时间较薄延长35%-50%；基于CR+ASM指标精度高，可为山洪预警提供依据。
papers.value: 揭示山坡产流多因子非线性阈值，构建CR+ASM指标，对山区小流域山洪预警与水利防灾备考有直接指导意义。

papers.title: 自然降雨特征和作物覆盖对三峡库区紫色土坡耕地产流产沙影响
papers.abstractEn: To address erosion on purple soil sloping farmland in the Three Gorges Reservoir area, this study used 108 natural rainfall events and runoff-sediment data from 2021-2023 across six standard runoff plots in the Fugou catchment, Chongqing, with K-means clustering and Pearson correlation. Results show rainfall was classified into three types: A (long duration, high amount), B (moderate), and C (short duration, high intensity). Type C dominated erosive rainfall, with critical rainfall amount, intensity, and maximum 30-min intensity of 6-21 mm, 1.1-3.6, and 1.2-7.6 mm/h, respectively. Sediment yield under type C reached 1.06-20.18 times that of types A and B. Compared with bare slopes, crop coverage reduced runoff and sediment by 61.67% and 77.15%, and a critical slope of 15°-25° was identified. The findings inform comprehensive soil erosion control on sloping farmland.
papers.abstractZh: 为探索三峡库区紫色土坡耕地侵蚀效应，基于重庆万州6个标准小区2021-2023年108场降雨与产流产沙数据，用聚类分析研究降雨及坡面产流产沙响应。结果表明降雨可分A、B、C三型，C型为侵蚀性主型；作物覆盖较裸坡减流61.67%、减沙77.15%，坡面存在15°-25°临界坡度。可为坡耕地水土流失治理提供参考。
papers.value: 量化紫色土坡耕地不同雨型产流产沙与作物覆盖减蚀效应，对坡耕地水土流失治理与备考有参考价值。
